'''Benedikt Löwe''' 
{{post-nominals|country=GBR|MAE}}
(born 1972) is a German [[mathematician]] and [[logic]]ian working at the
universities of [[University of Hamburg|Hamburg]] and [[University of Cambridge|Cambridge]].<ref>{{cite web
 | url = https://www.math.uni-hamburg.de/home/loewe/
 | title = UHH: Website Benedikt Löwe
 | access-date = 21 July 2019}}</ref>
He is known for his work on [[mathematical logic]] and the [[foundations of mathematics]], as well as for initiating the interdisciplinary conference series ''Foundations of the Formal Sciences'' (FotFS; 1999–2013) and ''[[Computability in Europe]]'' (CiE; since 2005).<ref>{{cite web
 | url =http://www.math.uni-bonn.de/people/fotfs/
 | title = Foundations of the Formal Sciences
 | access-date = 19 May 2013}}
{{cite web
 | url =https://www.acie.eu/cie-conference-series/
 | title = Computability in Europe Conference Series
 | date = 8 August 2016
 | access-date = 19 July 2019}}</ref>

== Biography ==

Löwe studied mathematics and philosophy at the universities of [[University of Hamburg|Hamburg]], [[University of Tübingen|Tübingen]], [[University of Berlin|HU Berlin]], and [[University of California, Berkeley|Berkeley]]. In 2001, he completed his PhD entitled ''Blackwell Determinacy'' about [[determinacy]] under supervision of [[Donald A. Martin]] and [[Ronald Björn Jensen]].<ref>{{MathGenealogy|id=35099}}</ref>
He worked at the [[Institute for Logic, Language and Computation]] of the [[University of Amsterdam]] from 2003 to 2023. In 2009, he was appointed professor for mathematical logic and interdisciplinary applications of logic at the [[University of Hamburg]]<ref>{{cite web
 | url = https://www.illc.uva.nl/Research/Programmes/loco/
 | title = UvA ILLC: Logic & Computation
 | access-date = 21 July 2019}}
{{cite web
 | url = https://www.math.uni-hamburg.de/spag/ml/
 | title = UHH: Arbeitsgruppe ML
 | access-date = 21 July 2019}}
</ref>
and is also an extraordinary fellow at [[Churchill College]] of the [[University of Cambridge]].<ref>{{cite web
 | url = https://www.chu.cam.ac.uk/people/view/benedikt-lowe/
 | title = Churchill College: Website Benedikt Löwe
 | access-date = 21 July 2019}}</ref>
Löwe was Managing Editor of the journal ''Mathematical Logic Quarterly'' from 2011 to 2022.<ref>{{cite web
 | url = https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/page/journal/15213870/homepage/2256_edbd.html
 | title = Wiley: MLQ Editorial Board
 | doi = 10.1002/(ISSN)1521-3870
 | access-date = 21 July 2019}}</ref>

He was the President of the [[German Association for Mathematical Logic and for Basic Research in the Exact Sciences]] (DVMLG) from 2012 to 2022 and the Secretary General of the ''Division for Logic, Methodology and Philosophy of Science and Technology'' of the [[International Union of History and Philosophy of Science|International Union of History and Philosophy of Science and Technology]]<ref>{{cite web
 | url = http://www.dlmpst.org/pages/council/council-2016-2019.php
 | title = DLMPST/IUHPST: Council Members 2016-2019
 | access-date = 21 July 2019}}</ref> from 2015 to 2023.
Since 2023, he is one of the Vice Presidents of the [[International Council for Philosophy and Human Sciences]] (CIPSH).<ref>{{cite web
 | url = https://cipsh.one/benedikt-lowe/
 | title = Benedikt Löwe — International Council for Philosophy and Human Sciences
 | website = CIPSH
 | access-date = 11 May 2024}}</ref>

He is a member of the [[International Academy for Philosophy of Science]],<ref>{{cite web
 | url = https://www.aips.be/en/benedikt-lowe
 | title = International Academy of the Philosophy of Science: BENEDIKT LÖWE
 | website = AIPS
 | access-date = 23 August 2023}}</ref> the [[Academia Europaea]] ([[Member of the Academia Europaea|MAE]]),<ref>{{cite web
 | url = https://www.ae-info.org/ae/Member/L%C3%B6we_Benedikt
 | title = Academy of Europe: Benedikt Löwe
 | website = Academia Europaea
 | access-date = 23 August 2023}}</ref> 
the 
[[Academy of Sciences and Humanities in Hamburg|Akademie der Wissenschaften in Hamburg]],<ref>{{cite web
 | url = https://www.awhamburg.de/mitglieder/ordentliche-mitglieder/detail/prof-dr-benedikt-loewe.html
 | title = Prof. Dr. Benedikt Löwe
 | website = Akademie der Wissenschaften in Hamburg
 | access-date = 11 May 2024}}</ref> 
and a Fellow of the [[International Science Council]] (FISC).<ref>{{cite web
 | url = https://council.science/profile/benedikt-lowe/
 | title = Benedikt Löwe — International Science Council
 | website = International Science Council
 | access-date = 11 May 2024}}</ref>

== Co-edited Volumes (a selection) ==
* 2006. ''Logical approaches to computational barriers : Second Conference on Computability in Europe, CiE 2006, Swansea, UK, June 30 – July 5, 2006; proceedings''. Co-edited with Arnold Beckmann, Ulrich Berger and [[John V. Tucker]].
* 2008. ''Games, scales, and Suslin cardinals''. Co-edited with [[Alexander S. Kechris]] and [[John R. Steel]]. Cambridge : Cambridge University 
* 2008. ''Logic and theory of algorithms : 4th Conference on Computability in Europe, CiE 2008, Athens, Greece, June 15 – 20, 2008; proceedings''. Co-edited with Arnold Beckmann and Costas Dimitracopoulos. Berlin; Heidelberg [u.a.] : Springer
* 2011. ''Wadge Degrees and Projective Ordinals The Cabal Seminar Volume II''. Co-edited with [[Alexander S. Kechris]] and [[John R. Steel]].
